svg.title: NetScope features
svg.desc: Inventory: Devices with IPs, MACs, vendor, type, tags, groups, notes and custom fields 15 scanners: ARP, ICMP, nmap, HTTP, TLS, SNMP, SSH, mDNS, UPnP, NetBIOS, DNS – live per host Agents & importers: Linux and Windows agent, firewalls, routers, UniFi, Meraki, Proxmox, Docker Changes & events: New devices, ports, services, certificates, containers and packages – diffed per run Vulnerabilities: CVE matching against a local NVD mirror, prioritised by CISA KEV and EPSS Health checks: TCP, HTTP, TLS and ICMP with flap damping, availability and outage history Topology: Graph from FDB, LLDP, ARP, Proxmox and Docker – zoom, filters, custom edges Rules & notifications: Bundling, quiet hours, throttling, escalation via Telegram, ntfy, e-mail, webhook, n8n Users & sign-in: Roles, two-factor sign-in (TOTP, passkeys), OIDC and LDAP / Active Directory Plugins & API: Every feature is a plugin with a settings schema; JSON API, OpenAPI, SSE, Prometheus
